earnings_fetched_note: Alpha Vantage 3-month CSV re-fetched (full refresh, not previously exhausted -- prior partial read was a local pipe-truncation artifact, re-pull succeeded, 1590 rows). Cross-checked against Finnhub earnings calendar for 2026-09-01..2026-09-05. Only watchlist name reporting in the window: Broadcom (AVGO), Sept 2 after close -- estimates diverge between sources (Finnhub ~$3.30 EPS/~$29.9B rev vs Alpha Vantage ~$2.83 EPS), likely differing analyst blends; reported as a range.
